 package main
 import("testing";"encoding/json";"reflect")
 func TestPublic(t *testing.T){var inputs []map[string]any;_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(`[{"events": [], "now": 100, "window": 10}, {"events": [{"user": "a", "at": 95, "units": 2}], "now": 100, "window": 10}]`),&inputs);var expected []any;_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(`[{}, {"a": 2}]`),&expected);for i,x:=range inputs{b,_:=json.Marshal(solve(x));var actual any;_ = json.Unmarshal(b,&actual);if !reflect.DeepEqual(actual,expected[i]){t.Fatalf("case %d: got %v want %v",i,actual,expected[i])}}}
+
+func TestRegression(t *testing.T){
+	var inputs []map[string]any
+	json.Unmarshal([]byte(`[
+		{"events": [], "now": 100, "window": 10},
+		{"events": [{"user": "a", "at": 90, "units": 2}], "now": 100, "window": 10},
+		{"events": [{"user": "a", "at": 100, "units": 2}], "now": 100, "window": 10},
+		{"events": [{"user": "a", "at": 89, "units": 2}], "now": 100, "window": 10},
+		{"events": [{"user": "a", "at": 101, "units": 2}], "now": 100, "window": 10},
+		{"events": [{"user": "a", "at": 95, "units": 0}], "now": 100, "window": 10},
+		{"events": [{"user": "a", "at": 95, "units": 2}, {"user": "b", "at": 110, "units": 5}, {"user": "c", "at": 85, "units": 3}], "now": 100, "window": 10}
+	]`), &inputs)
+
+	var expected []any
+	json.Unmarshal([]byte(`[
+		{},
+		{"a": 2},
+		{"a": 2},
+		{},
+		{},
+		{"a": 0},
+		{"a": 2}
+	]`), &expected)
+
+	for i, x := range inputs {
+		b, _ := json.Marshal(solve(x))
+		var actual any
+		json.Unmarshal(b, &actual)
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(actual, expected[i]) {
+			t.Fatalf("case %d: got %v want %v", i, actual, expected[i])
+		}
+	}
+}
